extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants, peer reviewers, and stakeholders interacting with CSR
extracted.subtask_description: High-level organizational standards and responsibilities that guide NIH peer review as stated by the Center for Scientific Review (CSR), including the qualities reviews should have and CSR's role in receipt and assignment of applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fair scientific reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: CSR works to see that NIH grant applications receive fair ... scientific reviews — so NIH can fund the most promising research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated as part of CSR's mission; implies reviewers should evaluate applications impartially and equitably.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent scientific reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: CSR works to see that NIH grant applications receive ... independent ... scientific reviews — free from inappropriate influences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of CSR's mission emphasizing that reviews should be conducted without undue external influence or conflicts compromising independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expert scientific reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: CSR works to see that NIH grant applications receive ... expert ... scientific reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSR expects reviews to be conducted by individuals with appropriate expertise to evaluate the science.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timely scientific reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: CSR works to see that NIH grant applications receive ... timely scientific reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSR emphasizes prompt review processing so funding decisions can proceed without undue delay.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviews free from inappropriate influences
rubrics_metrics.description: CSR works to see that NIH grant applications receive ... scientific reviews — free from inappropriate influences — so NIH can fund the most promising research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reiterates the requirement that review processes avoid improper pressures or biases; framed as central to CSR's mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: CSR scope and responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Center for Scientific Review (CSR) organizes the peer review of all NIH research proposals, cooperative agreements, and research & development contracts. We also receive all grant applications for NIH, as well as for some other components of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines CSR's procedural role in receipt, referral, and organization of peer review for NIH and some DHHS components; indicates where applicants should submit questions (Division of Receipt and Referral).
